name: Murder Inc.

tenures.role: tag team — CCW's first World Tag Team Champions (1 reign); of the House of Hurt
tenures.source: The fed's own "Explosion!!" PPV promo (/promotions/ccw-classic-1996/rp/ccw-classic-explosion-promo-1997-03-30.html; won the titles from the Devestation Express, billed to defend against Fire & Ice); the fed's own "CCW Slamfest" show script (/promotions/ccw-classic-1996/archive/ccw-classic-slamfest-1997-07-09.html; at ringside with the House of Hurt for the main event).

caption: CCW's first tag team champions, who beat the Devestation Express for the belts and stood with X.Plosion's House of Hurt; neither man is named in the fed's surviving record.
